note: Community-measured pull-rate estimates, expressed as packs per hit of ANY card of the rarity. Curated by hand; the UI must always label derived values as estimates. Per-card odds multiply by the count of that rarity in the set. Set-level entries override the game default. Rarities without an entry render as unavailable.
sources: Aggregated community opening data (JustInBasil-style rate summaries and TCGplayer pull-rate articles) for the Scarlet & Violet / Mega Evolution era; verify against current-set articles when adding overrides.
